title: pm-dispatch triage: the daily dashboard's lane section shows devx's six pipeline metrics (ruling #31424 rule 7), a ruled line with no written home
body:
domain:skills#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jT34CXs5fCn3BDirZw

Filing gate: (b) a follow-up a PR names. The director's contract review of PR #31552 (card #31424, record 6722830741, item ⑤) found that one ruled line has no written home after that PR. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

你裁定的第 7 条（#31424 附录 S，记录 6722123324）把 devx 定位为「AI 员工流水线效率」，并给了六项度量。其中最后一句是「分诊在每日看板的车道一节展示这些度量」。PR #31552 已经把定位和六项度量写进了 `lanes/devx.md`，但这句关于看板的话归分诊，不归车道文件，所以没写。这张卡只把这一句写进分诊的岗位说明（或看板规格）。

## Ask

- Write rule 7's last bullet where triage reads it: the daily dashboard's lane section shows devx's six metrics (CI wall time per PR, merge-queue wait p50/p90, cascade rebuilds, runner minutes per PR, flaky-test rate, dev-report false-green count). The text is in record 6722123324.
- Carrier: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`, or the dashboard's own spec if one exists. Point at `lanes/devx.md` for the metric list rather than restating it.
- Ceilings: pay by deletion or quote record 6722123324 under 6184799323 letter B.

## Not in scope

- Building or measuring the metrics. This card writes the rule only.

Related: #31424, PR #31552.
